answer: An operator running 244 keys thus pays for 244 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the beacon quota and the anchor admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 8 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the river ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
